description:
You are a security compliance analyst performing a quarterly audit of the OWASP Application Security Verification Standard (ASVS) document in this ReqView project. During a recent bulk import from the SRS document, several non-security functional requirements were accidentally imported into the ASVS document and are now mixed in among the legitimate OWASP security verification standards.

The ASVS document should contain ONLY items that are legitimate OWASP Application Security Verification Standard requirements (security verification controls, security testing requirements, and security architecture standards). Any items that describe general software functionality — such as file operations, document editing, reporting features, or integration capabilities — do not belong in the ASVS document and must be removed.

Identify and delete all items in the ASVS document that are NOT legitimate OWASP security verification standards. Be careful not to remove any real ASVS security requirements.

Login credentials: The application is already open with the project loaded.

injected_items.text_contains: move selected requirements or document sections
